question: Who has been appointed as the new Chairman of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)? (May 2025)
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Dr. Ajay Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Former Defence Secretary Ajay Kumar appointed as UPSC Chairman

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**President Droupadi Murmu** has appointed **Dr. Ajay Kumar** as the new **Chairman of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)**.

 
 
• 
 
The appointment was announced by the **Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT)**.

 
 
• 
 
**Dr. Kumar’s tenure** will begin **from the day he assumes charge**.

 
 
• 
 
He is a **retired IAS officer** from the **1985 batch**, **Kerala cadre**.

 
 
• 
 
Dr. Ajay Kumar served as **Defence Secretary** from **August 2019 to October 2022**.
